decision: OWNER DECISION — CONTINUE W1 PROFILE QUALIFICATION, KERNEL FROZEN (2026-09-19), section 10

incidents.what: a `python -c 'import aisef'` run with cwd=/private/tmp imported /private/tmp/inspect.py (a 2026-09-16 diagnostic script of another project) in place of the stdlib module: it ran `df -h` (read-only) and four `sudo docker exec goe-worker-1 ...` calls, all refused for lack of a password — nothing changed
incidents.impact: none — every sudo call was refused (no password); df -h is read-only
incidents.rule_from_now: qualification scripts never execute Python from shared writable directories such as /tmp: ad-hoc and scripted `python -c` use -P (safe_path) and a dedicated qualification workspace (~/Downloads/projects/aisef-qualification-ws) for temporary trees; the product kernel is not modified for this
